visual_review.notes: Reviewed on H3 video. Hit v1, defend v1 and cast v1 are clean. Death v1 skips one green-fringed frame of the fall (24). Idle v1 held each guide and popped between them; idle v3, guided by the neutral pose alone, loops smoothly. Attack v1 burst into shards and ranged v1 charged a glowing orb and fired a beam. The retakes say the cannon never fires and its crystals stay unlit and are guided through more painted poses, but both still flashed at contact: attack v2 cuts from the aim (40) to the lunge (50) and ranged v3 from the aim (46) to the recoil (59). The walk keeps the published clip. Re-matted 2026-10-14 with the green-plate spill limit: the green rims on thin and blurred edges are gone, with the same frames, timing, anchor and scale.
